arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
echo "REA_PREFLIGHT_BEGIN"
printf 'HOST_USER='; id -un
printf 'HOST_OS='; uname -s
printf 'PYTHON_VERSION='; python3 --version
printf 'CODEX_PATH='; command -v codex || echo absent
printf 'BWRAP_PATH='; command -v bwrap || echo absent
if command -v bwrap >/dev/null 2>&1; then bwrap --version; stat -c 'BWRAP_OWNER=%U MODE=%a' "$(command -v bwrap)"; fi
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/rea-plcodex-audit.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
git clone --quiet --depth 1 --branch main https://github.com/martaxi-boss/Project-leader-codex.git "$tmp/repo"
cd "$tmp/repo"
printf 'MAIN_SHA='; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'TREE_FILES='; git ls-files | wc -l
printf 'CONTROLS='; ls AGENTS.md CODEX_COORDINATION.md codex/dual.py codex/smart.py 2>&1
echo "TARGET_REFS:"
grep -R -n -E 'bwrap|sandbox|app-server|CODEX_HOME|_invoke_codex|read.only|Read.only|single|parallel|serial' codex/dual.py codex/smart.py codex/agent_policy.py 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,88p'
echo "REPO_CLEAN_BEGIN"
git status --porcelain
echo "REA_PREFLIGHT_END"
